_readme: Institutions (SYSTEMS §7). Each domain has two established institutions you can buy into (origin 'established', they exist from the start) and one you can found yourself (origin 'own'). Each has a named leader, a pre-authored leader integrity (honest / average / venal, DECIDED 2026-09-26) and 2 pre-authored drift paths. No general identity engine. Stakes and rivalry: DECIDED 2026-09-27, numbers PROPOSED P0-18.

institutions.name: the Physicians' Circle of the Subura
institutions.foundingIdentity: a teaching circle that treats the poor and questions every remedy

driftPaths.name: the Hospice of the Fountain
driftPaths.description: They stopped questioning remedies long ago. Now they only tend: free beds for anyone, in the founder's name.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Mother Theodota, twelfth Keeper of the Hospice

driftPaths.name: the Collegium of Physicians
driftPaths.description: A closed guild that sells cures to the rich, licenses who may practice, and sues anyone who treats the poor for free.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Flavius Demetrianus, Dean of the Collegium

institutions.joinText: Demetria of Pergamon takes your dues and writes your name in the Circle's book of members. She sets the rules; you have bought a seat, not a say.

institutions.name: the healers of the Tiber Island sanctuary
institutions.foundingIdentity: old temple healers who treat the sick with sleep, diet and votive offerings
institutions.joinText: Gaius Herennius Asper accepts your offering for the sanctuary's porticoes and adds your name to its list of benefactors.

driftPaths.name: the Infirmary of the Island
driftPaths.description: The porticoes became wards. They still leave offerings, but now they also keep records of who recovers.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Herennia Salvia, Mistress of the Infirmary

driftPaths.name: the Keepers of the Island Shrine
driftPaths.description: A shrine that sells cures by the dream and the amulet, and warns the city against any physician who asks too many questions.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Asper Minor, Keeper of the Shrine

institutions.name: the School of the Fountain
institutions.foundingIdentity: your own school of medicine: clean water, boiled linen, and notes on every patient
institutions.foundText: You rent two rooms by the fountain and hire Theon of Alexandria, a young physician with no patrons, to teach what you tell him. It is yours, and it is tiny.

driftPaths.name: the Academy of the Fountain
driftPaths.description: A teaching hospital that still boils its linen and still argues about why it works.

driftPaths.name: the Brotherhood of the Fountain
driftPaths.description: A closed brotherhood that guards the founder's notes as secrets and treats only its own.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Brother Theonas, Keeper of the Notes

institutions.name: the Caecilian faction
institutions.foundingIdentity: a senate bloc pledged to honest courts and public works

driftPaths.name: the Reform Bench
driftPaths.description: Still a bloc of reformers, but now they reform everything, endlessly, and nothing is ever finished.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Aurelia Caeciliana, Speaker of the Reform Bench

driftPaths.name: the Caecilian Houses
driftPaths.description: Three families who hold the city prefecture by inheritance and remember the founder only as a name on their gate.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Marcus Caecilius Varro, Prefect of the City

institutions.joinText: Senator Lucius Caecilius Varro accepts your gold for the faction's chest. He wants your money; you want his votes.

institutions.name: the Junian faction
institutions.foundingIdentity: an old senate bloc of landowners who guard the courts and the grain dole
institutions.joinText: Senator Quintus Junius Silvanus receives you in his atrium, takes your gift for the bloc, and promises nothing.

driftPaths.name: the Junian Bench
driftPaths.description: A family of magistrates who run the courts by the book, slowly, and for everyone.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Junia Silvana, President of the Bench

driftPaths.name: the Junian Estates
driftPaths.description: Landowners who hold half the province and the magistracies that tax it.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Quintus Junius Magnus, Lord of the Estates

institutions.name: the Club of the Aventine
institutions.foundingIdentity: your own dining club of equestrians and junior magistrates pledged to honest courts
institutions.foundText: You host a dinner on the Aventine for a dozen equestrians and junior magistrates. Titus Flavius Rufus agrees to lead them. It is yours, and it is small.

driftPaths.name: the Aventine Reformers
driftPaths.description: Still a club of reformers, still dining once a month, still writing laws no one else reads.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Flavia Rufina, President of the Aventine

driftPaths.name: the Aventine Clientele
driftPaths.description: A patronage machine that sells offices to its members' sons.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Flavius Rufus Magnus, Patron of the Aventine

institutions.name: the Merchants' Guild of Ostia
institutions.foundingIdentity: a guild of shippers and traders pledged to open markets and honest coin

driftPaths.name: the Free Traders of Ostia
driftPaths.description: Still traders, still arguing for open markets and honest coin, and grown rich and a little smug on both.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Aelia Sabina, Warden of the Free Traders

driftPaths.name: the Ostia Grain Cartel
driftPaths.description: A handful of houses that decide who may land grain at Ostia and at what price, and pay the magistrates to keep it so.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Gaius Sabinus Magnus, Master of the Cartel

institutions.joinText: Publius Aelius Sabinus, who ships grain from Alexandria, takes your dues at the guild hall in Ostia and enters you as a sleeping partner.

institutions.name: the banking house of Octavius at the Forum
institutions.foundingIdentity: moneychangers and lenders at the Forum who test coin and finance cargoes
institutions.joinText: Lucius Octavius Crispus weighs your coin twice, then writes you in as a depositor with a share in the house.

driftPaths.name: the Counting House of Octavius
driftPaths.description: A house that lends on honest coin at honest rates, and is trusted for it from Ostia to Alexandria.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Octavia Prisca, Mistress of the Counting House

driftPaths.name: the Creditors of the Treasury
driftPaths.description: Lenders to the emperors, paid in new coin and new taxes, who own more of Rome's debts than Rome does.

institutions.name: the trading house of Menodora
institutions.foundingIdentity: your own trading house: fair weights, written contracts, and credit on honest terms
institutions.foundText: You back Menodora, a freedwoman who trades oil and cloth, to open a house of your own by the river. It is yours, and it has one warehouse.

driftPaths.name: the House of Menodora
driftPaths.description: A trading house with agents in every port, famous for paying on the day it promises.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Menodora the Younger, Head of the House

driftPaths.name: the Menodoran Monopoly
driftPaths.description: A house that won a monopoly on oil from the magistrates and has not let go of it since.
driftPaths.arrivalLeader: Menodorus, Holder of the Oil Monopoly
